curb_weight_kg.notes: Canadian XSE AWD: 2,000 kg (4,409 lb) listed as Weight; applied to both 18- and 20-inch trims as the source gives one XSE AWD figure. US AWD SE 4,322 lb / XSE 4,366 lb differ. The cited page is the XSE AWD (20-inch) trim; the 18-inch SE AWD weight was not checked (US data suggests about 1 % lighter).

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: C-HR has a native NACS port (Toyota USA and Canada C-HR releases) and Toyota says Toyota BEV drivers can use the Tesla Supercharger network (Toyota Canada: 'Toyota BEV drivers are now able to enjoy charging through the Tesla Supercharger Network'; Toyota USA for the 2026 bZ). No Toyota page names the C-HR for Supercharger access.

Estimated: Canada. The C-HR has a native NACS port (Toyota Canada releases) and Toyota Canada says 'Toyota BEV drivers are now able to enjoy charging through the Tesla Supercharger Network' (lineup-wide). No Toyota page names this model for Supercharger access.

wheels.notes: SE: 18-in. wheels (US). This variant is the SE; the XSE has 20-in. wheels. Canadian trim AWD; size from the US SE page.
XSE carries 20-inch gunmetal wheels (listed as the larger size on this model). Canadian trim AWD; size from the US SE page.
